title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Namdev Finvest Limited (formerly known as Namdev Finvest Private Limited)
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated August 03, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹2.70 lakh (Rupees Two lakh seventy thousand only) on Namdev Finvest Limited (formerly known as Namdev Finvest Private Limited) (the company) for non-compliance with certain provisions of the ‘Reserve Bank of India (Know Your Customer (KYC)) Directions’ issued by RBI.
